title: 第 25章 望气术入门第 26章 在下不解经意但粗通火法
slug: 杀妖涨修为道爷我成了
lines: 沈回回到观中时，天色已近薄暮。
他与静明在膳堂门前作别，径自往自己那间小屋走去。
推开门，燃起灯，在床沿坐下。
直至此时，他方才有闲暇去看那界面。
他记得清楚，今早下山之前，这个数字还是三十三。杀了那狼妖之后，竟涨了二百九十四点。
二百九十四。
几乎抵得上他一月苦修的量。
沈回盯着那数字看了半晌，方才缓缓靠回床头。
头顶那团悬火跳了跳，照得满屋光影明灭。
原来如此。
他闭上眼，将这一天的事在脑子里过了一遍。
先前他只知晓两种积攒之法：一是打坐苦修，速度虽慢，但却胜在持久；二是吞食灵物，譬如之前吃过的灵果。
只是后者可遇不可求，寻常之物又无甚大用。
如今又多了一条路。
斩妖除魔。
这条路来得最快，杀一头狼妖便是近三百点修为，抵得上一个月苦功。
若是杀更厉害的妖呢？若是杀一群呢？
他睁开眼，望着黑漆漆的房梁，眼底闪过一丝光亮，随即又暗了下去。
只是这附近的妖物，怕是不多。
猫儿岭那狼妖算是成了些气候的，可也就那么一头。
往后再想找这等买卖，怕是得下山走远些了。
他正自出神，忽又想起二师姐那望气之术。
若是有那本事，能循着妖气追索妖物，日后下山除妖，岂不是方便得多？
他坐起身，看了看那三百二十七的数字，又看了看火法大成和筑基需要的各一万点，沉吟片刻，到底没有急着用。
“须得先学一门寻妖之法。”
他打定主意，又看了一眼界面上的数字，最后重新入定。
今日积累已达上限，可长夜漫漫，若只用来睡觉，岂不太过浪费？
枯坐一夜，果然又挤出一丝。
次日早课罢，沈回便往师父静室中去。
老道士正在窗边打坐，听他说明来意，也没多问，只指了指墙角那口旧木箱：“里头有卷帛书，自己寻去。”
沈回翻了一阵，找出一卷泛黄的帛卷，上头落满了灰。
他吹了吹灰，正要告辞，老道士忽然睁开眼：
“那狼妖，你杀的？”
沈回脚步一顿：“是。”
老道士点了点头，没再多问，又闭上了眼。
沈回揣着那卷帛书，回了自己屋里。
content_en:
When Shen Hui returned to the temple, it was almost dusk.
He said goodbye to Jingming in front of the dining hall and walked directly to his small room.
Open the door, light the lamp, and sit down on the edge of the bed.
Only then did he have time to look at the interface.
【Taoxing】：327
He remembered clearly that before going down the mountain this morning, the number was still thirty-three. After killing the wolf demon, it actually increased by 294 points.
Two hundred and ninety-four.
It was almost equal to his one month of hard training.
Shen Hui stared at the number for a long time before slowly leaning back on the bed.
The hanging fire above the head danced, illuminating the whole room with lights and shadows flickering.
I see.
He closed his eyes and went through the day's events in his mind.
Previously, he only knew two ways to accumulate: one was to meditate and practice hard, which was slow but long-lasting; the other was to swallow spiritual things, such as the spiritual fruits he had eaten before.
It's just that the latter is hard to come by, and ordinary things are of little use.
Now there is another way.
Kill demons and eliminate demons.
This way is the fastest. Killing a wolf monster is nearly 300 points of cultivation, which is worth a month of hard work.
What if we kill a more powerful monster? What if we kill a group of people?
He opened his eyes and looked at the dark beams. A glimmer of light flashed in his eyes, and then darkened again.
It's just that there aren't many monsters around here.
The wolf demon in Mao'er Ridge has become somewhat mature, but it's just that one.
If I want to find this kind of business in the future, I'm afraid I'll have to go further down the mountain.
He was lost in thought when he suddenly remembered Second Senior Sister's Qi-gazing technique.
If you have that ability, wouldn't it be much more convenient to follow the evil spirit to track down the monsters and go down the mountain to eliminate the monsters in the future?
He sat up, looked at the number of three hundred and twenty-seven, and then looked at the 10,000 points needed for the Great Fire Technique and the 10,000 points for Foundation Establishment. He pondered for a moment, but he was not in a hurry to use it.
"You must first learn a method of hunting monsters."
He made up his mind, took another look at the numbers on the interface, and finally entered samadhi again.
Today's accumulation has reached the upper limit, but the night is long. Wouldn't it be a waste if it was only used for sleeping?
…
After sitting there all night, I squeezed out another trace.
After morning class the next day, Shen Hui went to Master's quiet room.
The old Taoist priest was meditating by the window. Hearing him explain his purpose, he didn't ask any questions. He just pointed to the old wooden box in the corner and said, "There are scrolls in there. Find them yourself."
Shen Hui rummaged for a while and found a yellowed silk roll covered with dust.
He blew the ashes and was about to leave when the old Taoist priest suddenly opened his eyes:
"Did you kill the wolf demon?"
Shen stepped back and said, "Yes."
The old Taoist priest nodded, didn't ask any more questions, and closed his eyes again.
Shen Hui took the silk book and returned to his room.
title_en: Chapter 25: Introduction to Qi-gazing Chapter 26: I don’t understand the meaning of the scriptures, but I am familiar with the art of fire.
